description: This file defines a C# interface `ICollectionTestGrain` within the namespace `UnitTests.GrainInterfaces`. The interface extends `IGrainWithIntegerKey` and declares several asynchronous methods for grain operations, such as getting age, incrementing a counter, deactivation, setting references to other grains, retrieving grain references, and starting timers.

classes.name: ICollectionTestGrain
classes.description: An interface for a grain with integer key that provides methods for testing collection and referencing among grains.

methods.name: GetAge
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the age as a TimeSpan.

methods.name: IncrCounter
methods.description: Asynchronously increments an internal counter and returns its new value.

methods.name: SetOther
methods.description: Sets a reference to another ICollectionTestGrain.

methods.name: GetOtherAge
methods.description: Retrieves the age from the referenced other grain.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to another ICollectionTestGrain.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime instance ID of the grain.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer with specified period and delay.
